summary: Made the LLM connection settings resilient when the bundled local llm_bridge is down by adding a FastAPI-side lazy autostart path, one-shot retry behavior, and clearer setup guidance for users connecting external models.
features_completed: Added appforge/llm_bridge_process.py to start the bundled Bun llm_bridge on demand for local loopback bridge URLs.
Updated /api/llm/* routes to retry once after a network-level BridgeError by invoking the local bridge manager.
Kept HTTP bridge errors such as unknown provider responses out of the autostart path so real bridge validation errors remain visible.
Updated the LLM bridge error handler to surface action guidance supplied by the autostart manager, including Bun missing, node_modules missing, non-loopback URL, and startup timeout cases.
Added focused web tests for connection-refused retry, autostart failure guidance, and non-autostart HTTP errors.
Verified that a real local autostart returns provider IDs including openai, anthropic, google, openrouter, xai, deepseek, groq, and cerebras when run outside the network sandbox.

decisions: Autostart is limited to http loopback bridge URLs to avoid trying to manage remote bridge services.
The manager uses subprocess argv with no shell interpolation and passes host/port through APPFORGE_LLM_BRIDGE_HOST and APPFORGE_LLM_BRIDGE_PORT.
Network-level BridgeError status_code 0 triggers autostart and one retry; bridge HTTP errors are returned as-is.
Bun dependency installation is not run implicitly from a settings-panel request; missing node_modules returns an actionable message instead of surprising network work.
The FastAPI lifespan shuts down only the bridge process it started, preserving already-running external bridge processes.
known_gaps: A live third-party provider test still requires the user's real API key and was not attempted.
If llm_bridge/node_modules is missing, the settings panel now gives guidance but does not auto-run bun install.
Local bind/runtime checks require running outside the restricted command sandbox; sandboxed checks still cannot prove localhost server behavior.
